subject.title: docs(maint): raise PR close batch limit

question: Should bulk close/reopen confirmation stay at 5 PRs, move to 20 PRs, or be centralized under another maintainer mutation-safety threshold?
rationale: This is a maintainer workflow safety policy choice, and automation should not decide how many public PRs can be closed or reopened without exact-count confirmation.

options.title: Align on the 20-PR threshold
options.body: Update clawdtributor and any composed close/reopen instructions to match the new >20 PR guard before merging.

options.title: Keep the 5-PR threshold
options.body: Leave both skills at the stricter existing guard until maintainers explicitly approve a broader bulk-mutation policy.

options.title: Centralize the policy first
options.body: Pause this PR and replace duplicated threshold text with one canonical policy reference.

recommendation.title: Align on the 20-PR threshold
recommendation.body: Update clawdtributor and any composed close/reopen instructions to match the new >20 PR guard before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current threshold proposal and has recent ownership signal on the affected maintainer docs surface.
